gaps.sentence: The refugees celebrated their ___ (FREE) at last.
The problem was ___ (SIMPLE) a matter of bad timing.
gaps.explanation: 'Simply a matter of' = only a matter of.

gaps.sentence: She explained the process ___ (PATIENT) to each visitor.
She beat three hundred ___ (COMPETE) for the title.
gaps.hint: plural noun: the people she beat
gaps.explanation: 'Three hundred competitors' — plural noun for the people taking part.

gaps.sentence: The factory will ___ (EMPLOY) fifty more workers next year.
gaps.explanation: The bare verb follows 'will': will employ.

gaps.sentence: The government made a formal ___ (DECLARE) of intent to invest in rail.
gaps.explanation: 'A formal declaration' — the noun follows the adjective.

gaps.sentence: The thief was ___ (ARREST) at the border.
